name: Composer (history)

test_list.description: Up through the history and Down past the newest restores the unsent draft with its cursor.
history_prev needs first_row=true and history_next needs last_row=true; otherwise nothing changes.
Repeated prev walks newest to oldest and stops at the oldest; next walks back.
Consecutive identical submissions are stored once and [Image N] markers are not stored.
After any number of prev then the same number of next, the draft equals the original.

inputs.name: first_row/last_row
inputs.description: Whether the cursor is on the first/last visual row (caller computes).

output_description: True when the buffer was replaced by a history entry or the draft.
